Implemented the fix in `internal/terraform/transform_attach_config_resource.go`.

The transformer now collects removed blocks across the entire configuration tree and matches them by absolute resource address, so `removed` blocks targeting resources inside modules are attached correctly—even when the module itself has been removed from configuration. - `go test ./internal/terraform -count=1`
- `go test ./internal/refactoring ./internal/configs -count=1`
